claims.text: The hotel is on Kent Street in Millers Point, equidistant to Barangaroo, Walsh Bay and The Rocks.

findings.quote: The Langham, Sydney resides on Kent Street in Millers Point, one of Sydney's longest streets, and sits equidistant to Barangaroo, Walsh Bay and 'The Rocks'

claims.text: The hotel is in an Irish Georgian-style building.

findings.quote: The Langham, Sydney resides in a beautiful Irish Georgian-style building

claims.text: The hotel has a wall mural of Bondi Beach in the 90s.

findings.quote: be sure to admire the wall mural of Bondi Beach in the 90s!

claims.text: The Observatory Suite has a grand dining room and views of Observatory Hill and the Sydney skyline.

findings.quote: Entertain your guests in a grand dining room, and impress them with majestic views of Observatory Hill and the Sydney skyline.

claims.text: Premier Terrace Rooms are on the third floor and have a balcony overlooking the city and Western Harbour.

findings.quote: Located on the third floor, our signature balcony and Premier Terrace Rooms overlook the bustling city and Western Harbour.

claims.text: The Residence is a two-bedroom, two-bathroom suite with a modern kitchenette and skyline views.

findings.quote: The Residence is a two-bedroom and two-bathroom suite with a modern kitchenette and skyline views.

claims.text: All rooms have a marble bathroom with double basins and a separate bath and shower.

findings.quote: All rooms have a marble bathroom with double basins and a separate bath and shower.

claims.text: Afternoon Tea in the Palm Court is served with Wedgwood tableware and can be paired with Champagne.

findings.quote: Afternoon Tea with Wedgwood tableware in the chic Palm Court can be paired with Champagne.

claims.text: Bistro Remy serves breakfasts and dinners made with local produce.

findings.quote: Bistro Remy harnesses local produce for tasty breakfasts and dinners

claims.text: The pool has a starry ceiling that is a painted replica of the Southern Hemisphere.

findings.quote: Look up for a beautiful starry ceiling — a painted replica of the Southern Hemisphere.

claims.text: The Observatory Suite and Observatory Bar pay homage to the Sydney Observatory, which is just opposite the hotel.

findings.quote: Our Observatory Suite and Observatory Bar pay homage to the Sydney Observatory just opposite the hotel.

claims.text: The Day Spa by Chuan is underground and offers massages, body treatments and facials.

findings.quote: Lavish underground sanctuary The Day Spa by Chuan is renowned for healing massages, body treatments and facials.

claims.text: The hotel has a championship-size tennis court just opposite the hotel.

findings.quote: Take a swing at our very own championship-size tennis court just opposite the hotel.

claims.text: The Langham Pink Taxi, a rose-hued London cab, takes guests around the area free of charge for meetings, shopping and dining.

findings.quote: The free Langham Pink Taxi (a rose-hued London cab) ferries guests around the area for meetings, shopping and dining.

claims.text: The Pampered Pets programme offers pet-sitting and dog-walking services for a fee.

findings.quote: The Langham’s Pampered Pets programme extends five-star treatment to your furry friends for a fee, with pet-sitting and dog-walking services.

claims.text: An extra bed for a third guest is available on request in rooms with King or two double beds.

findings.quote: with the choice of King or two double beds. An extra bed for a third guest is available on request.
